methods.summary: Draconic - the dragonbane Dragon hunter lance is the recommended main weapon. Anti-dragon / Dragonfire shield advised.

methods.label: Dragonfire and lair access
methods.summary: Prepare dragonfire protection and manage the short Wilderness run to the King Black Dragon lair.
prayers: Protect from Magic or relevant offensive prayer
steps: Bring layered dragonfire protection before entering the lair.
Cross the Wilderness entrance quickly and enter the lair to leave the PvP area.
Keep antifire active throughout the kill.
Refresh supplies before returning through the Wilderness.
risks: The route to the lair is in the Wilderness.
Inadequate dragonfire protection can cause heavy damage.

methods.label: Dragonbane melee or ranged
methods.summary: Use dragonbane melee or ranged weapons to kill KBD while handling poison and special dragonfire effects.
steps: Use Dragon hunter lance for melee or Dragon hunter crossbow for ranged where available.
Bring antipoison or venom handling for poison dragonfire.
Eat through unavoidable special dragonfire effects and maintain offensive prayer.
Loot and reset before supplies run low.
notes: KBD is draconic, so dragonbane weapons are central to the strategy.
